label: PF Backlog 511
title: E5: reviewer extras (test adequacy, contract conformance, migration/back-compat, config/secrets, failure modes, idempotency, observability, rollback)
body:
## Problem / why
Beyond security/perf/edges, the reviewer should catch test-thinness, contract drift, unsafe migrations,
undeclared config/secrets, missing timeouts, non-idempotent writes, missing observability, and non-revertible changes.

## Acceptance criteria
The review-focus checklist includes these categories with pass/fail criteria; the code-review agent checks them.

## Out of scope
Changing pr_gate mechanics.
